definition: ConstituentOf p x: p is one of the principles x is constituted by (its matter or form, its essence or its act of being), quantified over the same Principle sort as essenceOf and esseOf in q.3 a.7. Distinct from ComponentOf (DEF-COMPOSITION-COMPONENT), which ranges over beings. Only the open analysis STMT-TWO-DISTINCT-CONSTITUENTS-MAKE-COMPOSITE links it to Composite (two distinct constituents suffice); no converse is assumed, and nothing says a simple being has no constituent. In Lean a parameter P -> B -> Prop.
